summary: A Hammond B3 tonewheel organ modelled on the setBfree emulator, with upper, lower and pedal manuals and a Leslie. Version 0.3, tested on one unit.
features: 91 tonewheels, nine drawbars, leakage, key click and key compression
Vibrato and chorus V1-C3, percussion, overdrive and reverb
Leslie with horn and drum: stop, slow and fast
All 110 setBfree programs by knob or MIDI program change
USB and TRS MIDI: channels 1-3 play upper, lower and pedal
Sound measured against setBfree; USB audio input for recording

headings: b3 organ for the m-vave fm-1
measured against a raspberry pi running setbfree
